title: Software team
description: The standard software-development fleet: a PM that plans and delegates, an architect, backend and frontend engineers, a designer and a reviewer. Point the project at your repository (Settings → General) and give tasks to the PM.
audience: A developer who wants agents to work on a codebase.

resources.title: Project conventions
resources.description: How this codebase is built and checked: stack, folders, naming, commands (run / test / lint), branch and commit rules, definition of done. Agents follow it. FILL IT IN.

schedules.name: Dev — weekly health check
schedules.text: Weekly health check of the repository: read the project conventions, run the lint/test/typecheck commands, look at outdated or vulnerable dependencies and recent failing CI runs, and report what needs attention (no code changes) with the most important first.

after: 1) Settings → General: set the repository (and a GitHub token) or work in a local folder. 2) Fill in 📚 Resources → "Project conventions" (commands, stack, rules). 3) Give a task to the PM: "Implement …". For Telegram control, ask the admin: "connect Telegram".
